---
title: "Glossary"
description: "Every term in the course, with a plain-English definition and the chapter that teaches it."
execute:
  freeze: false
---

Every term is defined where the course first teaches it. This page collects those
definitions. Use the search box (top left) or your browser's find for quick lookups,
and follow the chapter link for the full picture.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import re, yaml
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("..") if Path("../chapters").exists() else Path(".")
entries = {}
for qmd in sorted((root / "chapters").rglob("*.qmd")):
    if not (root / "planning" / "reviews" / f"{qmd.stem[:5]}.done").exists():
        continue
    text = qmd.read_text()
    m = re.match(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---", text, re.S)
    if not m:
        continue
    fm = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) or {}
    for term, val in (fm.get("glossary") or {}).items():
        slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", str(term).lower()).strip("-")
        if isinstance(val, dict):  # {def: "...", aliases: ["...", ...]}
            definition, aliases = val.get("def", ""), val.get("aliases") or []
        else:
            definition, aliases = val, []
        entries.setdefault(slug, (str(term), str(definition).strip(), qmd, fm.get("title", qmd.stem), None))
        for al in aliases:
            aslug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", str(al).lower()).strip("-")
            entries.setdefault(aslug, (str(al), "", qmd, fm.get("title", qmd.stem), (term, slug)))

if not entries:
    print("*The glossary fills in as chapters are written.*")
letter = None
for slug, (term, definition, qmd, title, alias_of) in sorted(entries.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][0].lower()):
    first = term[0].upper() if term[0].isalpha() else "#"
    if first != letter:
        letter = first
        print(f"\n## {letter}\n")
    rel = Path("..") / qmd.relative_to(root)
    if alias_of:
        print(f"[**{term}**]{{#gl-{slug}}}\n:   See [{alias_of[0]}](#gl-{alias_of[1]}).\n")
    else:
        print(f"[**{term}**]{{#gl-{slug}}}\n:   {definition} *Taught in [{title}]({rel.as_posix()}).*\n")
```
